project_type: React SPA with Supabase backend - modular wall design and BOM platform
build_command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
test_command: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx vitest run
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit. 2. Run tests: unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd frontend && npx vitest run. Known pre-existing errors: ValidationOverlayLayer.tsx unused var, usePermissionEnforcement.test.ts iterator type error - these are not our concern.
setup_instructions: cd frontend && npm install (node_modules already present)
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode. Node.js v22.23.2 available. Must unset NODE_OPTIONS before running npm/npx commands due to proxy-bootstrap.js preload issue. Supabase project fbiemsbykrmrbqcsobvh deployed but no direct DB access from sandbox.
contribution_requirements: Push to feat/db-baseline-v1.1.5 branch. Database schema is frozen at v1.1.5 baseline. Frontend types MUST match actual DB column names (template_id not id, zone_id not id, etc.)
key_patterns: Zustand stores in src/stores/. Canvas uses react-konva with layers pattern. Engines are pure functions in src/engines/. Supabase client via fromTable() helper in src/lib/supabase.ts. ErrorCatalogue pattern for pipeline errors. Interactions as custom hooks in src/canvas/interactions/.
directory_structure: Root: baseline/, ci/, docs/, frontend/, migrations/, tests/. Frontend: src/canvas/ (CanvasContainer, layers/, interactions/, history/, permissions/, utils/, __tests__), src/engines/ (pure calculation engines + __tests__), src/stores/ (10 Zustand stores + __tests__), src/types/ (database.ts, canvas.ts), src/lib/ (supabase.ts, snapshotBuilder.ts, coordinates.ts, autosave.ts)
